data.name: Ahtisham
data.gender_notes: Ahtisham is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ahtisham is a noble Arabic name meaning 'grace', 'magnificence', or 'dignity'. It symbolizes someone who carries themselves with grandeur, respect, and inner poise. It is widely used in Muslim cultures to denote noble presence and honor. The name Ahtisham carries the meaning “Dignity, Magnificence, Grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Ahtisham usually hope their child will grow to embody dignity, magnificence, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ahtisham reflects a soul that walks with grace, earns respect through actions, and inspires awe through humility.
data.etymology: Ahtisham belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dignity, Magnificence, Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ahtisham total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: أَحْتِشَام
in_arabic.meaning: الاسم يدلُ على الإشراقِ والنُورِ والعِلمِ
in_arabic.long_meaning: يُنْبَتُ مِنْ جذْرَةِ "حَشِمَ" الَّتِي تُشيرُ إلى الإشْراقِ والنُورِ والعِلمِ. يُفَسِّرُ بعضُ المُتَخَصِّصِينَ أَنَّهُ يُعْنِي بِالشَّجْعَةِ والعِزَّةِ. لمْ يُرَجِحَ في المُصَاحِفِ وَالِأَدْبِ الإسلاميِّ اسْتِخْدامُ هذا الاسْمِ بكثرةٍ، وَلَكنَّهُ يُعَدُّ اسماًً جميلاًً ذوَ مَنىً عَظِيماً.

in_urdu.name: احتشام
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسم "احتشام" عربی زبان سے ہے اور اس کا اُصول "حَشِمَ" سے ملتا ہے۔ "حَشِمَ" کے معنی ہیں روشنی، علم اور فضل۔ اس کا اطلاق روشنی والے چہرے، علم والے، اور فضل والے شخص پر ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام روایتی طور پر استعمال نہیں کیا جاتا تھا لیکن اس کا معنی خوبصورت اور روحانی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अह्तिषाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम "अह्तिषाम" अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसका मूल "حَشِمَ" से जुड़ा है। "حَشِمَ" का अर्थ है प्रकाश, ज्ञान और पराक्रम। यह नाम प्रकाशमान चेहरे, ज्ञानी और पराक्रमी व्यक्ति को दर्शाता है। यह नाम पारंपरिक रूप से इस्तेमाल नहीं किया जाता था परंतु इसका अर्थ सुंदर और आध्यात्मिक है।

in_pashto.long_meaning: اسم "احتشام" لهجة عربي څخه راځي او د "حَشِمَ" ریشه له خواسته چې نور، علم او شجاعت لري. دې نوم د نورवाल चेhr، عالم او شجاع شخص ته اشاره کوي. دا نوم په غزنی او پښان ثقافې کې په زياته اندازه کارول نه شوې، له خواسته چې په معنی يې نور او روحاني وي.

in_english.name: Ahtisham
in_english.long_meaning: Ahtisham is an Arabic name derived from the root "حَشِمَ", meaning "to shine, to enlighten, to be brilliant". It often signifies intelligence, knowledge, and spiritual radiance. While not frequently encountered in classical Islamic texts, Ahtisham carries a positive connotation of excellence and enlightenment in modern Muslim cultures.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ahtisham encapsulates the heritage and values of Islamic tradition. For Muslims, possessing qualities such as grace, magnificence, and dignity is a mark of morality and respect in society. Utilizing this name in addressing individuals can remind them of their potential ability to embody these noble traits, inspiring them towards becoming better versions of themselves and contributing positively to their communities.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, the name Ahtisham conveys the idea of having a refined soul that is enlightened and magnanimous. This name serves as a reminder of its carrier's divine connection to the Creator, motivating them to strive for inner beauty and excellence, just as the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) demonstrated throughout his life. Embodied with such virtues, the owner of this name is able to interact with others gracefully, projecting a strong sense of inner strength and wisdom.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Ahtisham means "protector of faith" or "defender of the truth." It is a name that evokes courage, strength, and commitment to one's beliefs. Those named Ahtisham are encouraged to be steadfast in their faith and to stand up for what is right, protecting it from harm.
